exposure: Level of hospital birth (Level III vs. others)
outcome: Prevalence of neonatal hypoxemic respiratory failure (NRF)

finding: This study found a 13.3‰ prevalence of neonatal hypoxemic respiratory failure (NRF) in a regional network in China, with an 18.4% mortality rate, and identified various perinatal risk factors associated with mortality.
